messages:
Maya: Quick micro thing — two items:
1) Emergency chocolate restock? Who can grab? :chocolate_bar:
2) Two-word Slack-status challenge. Best one-liner wins brag emoji.

Sam: I can pick up chocolate after lunch. Dark only pls. :raised_hands:

Jamie: Vote: salted caramel. Also status: "Keyboard whisperer" :keyboard:

Oliver: Coconut chips are cursed. veto. :no_good:

Liam: Status idea: "Inbox ninja" or "Laptop survivor". Both solid.

Maya: Love 'Inbox ninja'. Poll: /poll "Snack" "Dark chocolate" "Milk chocolate" "Salted caramel" — react with 1/2/3/4

Sam: Also kudos to @jamie for fixing the meeting room A projector earlier :tada:

Jamie: thanks! quick one-liner: "Bring cake, leave crumbs." :cake:

Oliver: One-liner battle entry: "Silent sipper" (for the stealth tea people)

Liam: One-liner vote: my heart says 'Keyboard whisperer'.

kudos-bot: Jamie received 1 kudos from Sam — "projector hero" :clap:

Maya: Okay chocolate consensus looks like Dark chocolate wins. I'll snag a bar. Winner of status challenge: tie between 'Inbox ninja' and 'Keyboard whisperer' — both winners get :trophy:

Sam: Remind me to add coconut-chip boycott to office rules. :sweat_smile:

Jamie: Also: office plant needs watering. Quick volunteer? :seedling:

Oliver: I'll water it today.

Maya: Perfect. Micro-mission accomplished. End of thread. :sparkles:
